title.en: Fan is locked when inverter is off.
title.ur: Pankha band hai jab inverter off ho

meaning.en: Fan cannot rotate while the inverter is off; fan fault reported.
meaning.ur: inverter band hone ki haalat main Pankha nahin ghoom raha fan kharabi.

causes.en: Fan fault (obstruction, bearing seize or fan failure).
causes.ur: Pankha kharab — pankha ruka hua, bearing jam gayi ya fan kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Fan connector loose or fan supply wire broken.
causes.ur: Fan ka connection dheela hai ya supply wire tooti hui hai.

causes.en: Main board fan driver circuit failed.
causes.ur: Main board ka fan driver circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC input and PV, open the DC breaker and wait 5 minutes; then open the cover and look for dust, wires or a foreign object blocking the fan blades.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC input aur PV band karein, DC breaker kholein aur 5 minute intezar karein; phir cover khol kar dekhein ke pankha ki blades par dhool, taar ya koi cheez atki hui hai.

solutions.en: With power isolated, spin the fan by hand — it must turn freely; check the fan plug is seated on the board and has no burn marks.
solutions.ur: Power band hone ke baad pankha haath se ghuma kar dekhein — ise azaadi se ghumna chahiye; fan ka plug board par theek laga hai aur us par jale hue nishan to nahin, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: If the fan is stuck or does not run after restart, replace it with the same size fan and retest the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar pankha atka hua hai ya restart ke baad bhi nahin chalta, to usi size ka naya fan lagayein aur unit ko dobara test karein.

meaning.en: Internal over-temperature trip: converter component over 120°C and/or inverter component over 100°C.
meaning.ur: Andaruni over-temperature trip: converter component 120°C se zyada aur/ya inverter component 100°C se zyada.

causes.en: Air flow of the unit is blocked / ambient temperature too high.
causes.ur: hawa ka rasta band ya mahol ka darja hararat zyada

causes.en: Internal converter component over 120°C; inverter component over 100°C.
causes.ur: Converter 120°C se aur inverter 100°C se zyada

solutions.en: Turn off AC input and PV, let the unit cool for 10–15 minutes, and clear anything blocking the vents; clean dust from the filters and heat sinks.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band kar ke unit ko 10-15 minute thanda hone dein, vent ke saamne jo rukawat hai hata dein; filters aur heat sinks se dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: After cooling, restart the unit with a lighter load and listen that the cooling fan runs; also check the room ambient is not too hot.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone par kam load ke sath unit restart karein aur sun kar maaloom karein ke pankha chal raha hai; kamre ka temperature bhi check karein ke woh bohat zyada to nahin.

solutions.en: If the trip comes back with clear airflow, the temperature sensor (NTC) or fan is faulty — have the board checked at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar hawa ka rasta saaf hone ke baad bhi trip wapas aa jaye, to temperature sensor (NTC) ya pankha kharab hai — board ko service centre se check karwayein.

causes.en: Battery spec/quantity does not meet requirements.

solutions.en: Battery over-charged: return to repair center.
solutions.ur: Battery over-charge ho gayi hai: marammat ke markaz wapas jayein.

solutions.en: Check if spec and quantity of batteries meet requirements.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: Battery voltage below operating threshold; unit trips (e.g. <1.91V/cell during startup).
meaning.ur: Battery voltage chalti ki had se neeche; unit trip ho jata hai (misal ke tor par start ke dauran <1.91V/cell).

causes.en: The battery voltage is too low (<1.91V/Cell).
causes.ur: battery voltage bohat kam (<1.91V/cell)

causes.en: Battery voltage far too low (<1.4V/Cell) or internal fuse tripped.
causes.ur: Voltage bahat zyada kam (<1.4V/cell) ya andaruni fuse jal chuka hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV first, then measure the battery pack voltage with a multimeter; charge the battery before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC input aur PV alag karein, phir multimeter se battery pack ka voltage naapein; aur testing se pehle battery ko charge kar lein.

solutions.en: Check battery terminals and wiring for loose clamps or a blown main fuse; tighten or replace whatever is found faulty.
solutions.ur: Battery ke terminals aur wiring check karein ke clamps dheele to nahin ya main fuse to nahi uda; jo kharab mila use theek karein ya badal dein.

solutions.en: Load-test the battery — if voltage collapses under load or a cell is dead, recharge or replace the battery and restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Battery ka load-test karein — load par voltage gir jaye ya koi cell khaali ho to battery charge ya replace kar ke unit dobara start karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: Inverter output voltage abnormal/high (troubleshooting band: above ~260Vac).
meaning.ur: Output voltage ghair mamooli ya zyada (~260Vac se zyada)

causes.en: Output abnormal (inverter voltage below 190Vac or higher than 260Vac).
causes.ur: output ghair mamooli (190Vac se kam ya 260Vac se zyada)

causes.en: Heavy load drags the output voltage outside the band.
causes.ur: Bhari load ki wajah se output voltage band se bahar chala jata hai.

causes.en: Output stage / AVR component on the main board failed.
causes.ur: Main board ka output stage ya AVR component kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: First switch off heavy loads and non-essential equipment so the inverter runs light, then measure the AC output with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle bhari load aur zaroori na honay wale appliances band kar dein taake inverter halke load par chale, phir multimeter se AC output naapein.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated from mains, check the output wiring and terminal connections for looseness or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Unit ko mains se alag kar ke output wiring aur terminal connections check karein ke kahin dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin.

solutions.en: If the output is still above the limit with a light load, stop and return the unit to the repair centre — the output stage needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar halke load par bhi output phir bhi limit se upar rahe, to unit ko repair centre le jayein — output stage ki service zaroori hai.

meaning.en: Load exceeded 110% until the overload timer expired (or PV-derating overload path); output cut.
meaning.ur: Load 110% se zyada raha aur overload timer khatam ho gaya (ya PV derating ka overload rasta); output band.

causes.en: Overload error: the inverter is overloaded 110% and time is up.
causes.ur: Overload error: inverter 110% se zyada load par tha aur waqt khatam ho gaya.

causes.en: PV input voltage higher than specification caused derating; load higher than derated output power → overload.
causes.ur: PV input voltage specification se zyada hone ki wajah se output power ki derating hui; load derated power se zyada raha → overload.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load by switching off some equipment.
solutions.ur: Kuch aalat band kar ke load kam karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of PV modules in series or the connected load.
solutions.ur: series main PV models ya load kam karein

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: Internal DC bus over-voltage trip.
meaning.ur: Andaruni DC bus par over-voltage trip.

causes.en: Internal components failed.
causes.ur: Andaruni components kharab

causes.en: Load dump or regenerative energy pushed the DC bus above the limit.
causes.ur: Load dump ya regenerative energy ne DC bus ko limit se upar kar diya.

causes.en: DC bus capacitor or bleed resistor failed.
causes.ur: DC bus capacitor ya bleed resistor kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power off, switch off AC input and PV and wait 5 minutes; do not probe the DC bus — dangerous voltage stays stored in the capacitors.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, AC input aur PV off kar ke 5 minute intezar karein; DC bus par probe na rakhein — capacitors mein khatarnak voltage reh jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the cover only with supply isolated and look for burnt parts, bulged capacitors or loose connections; do not power it up again.
solutions.ur: Sirf supply band hone par cover kholein aur jalay hue parts, phoolay hue capacitors ya dheele connections dekhein; dobara power na dein.

solutions.en: If the fault repeats after a restart, the bus or soft-start components have failed — send the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Agar restart ke baad bhi fault aa jaye, to bus ya soft-start components kharab ho chuke hain — unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: DC bus could not soft-start to operating voltage.
meaning.ur: DC bus apni operating voltage tak soft start nahi ho saka.

causes.en: Internal components failed (user manual).
causes.ur: Andaruni components kharab (service manual)

causes.en: DC-DC module damaged or BUS soft-start module damaged (service manual); check TX1 if no other damage found.
causes.ur: DC-DC module ya bus soft-start module kharab (service manual); agar koi aur kharabi na mile to TX1 check karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, wait 5 minutes, then restart once and watch whether the bus comes up or the code returns immediately.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute ruk kar ek baar restart karein aur dekhein ke bus upar aata hai ya code foran wapas aa jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the DC input wiring and main fuse for looseness or damage; do not probe the high-voltage bus yourself.
solutions.ur: DC input wiring aur main fuse check karein ke dheela ya kharab to nahin; high-voltage bus par khud probe na karein.

solutions.en: Since the DC-DC or BUS soft-start stage has failed, send the unit to the repair centre for board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Kyunki DC-DC ya BUS soft-start stage kharab hai, unit ko board-level repair ke liye repair centre bhej dein.

meaning.en: Inverter over-current / surge trip.
meaning.ur: Inverter over-current / surge trip kar deta hai.

causes.en: Over current or surge.
causes.ur: Over current ya surge.

causes.en: Motor or inductive load inrush current at start-up.
causes.ur: Motor ya inductive load ka start par inrush current.

causes.en: Short or insulation fault on the output wiring.
causes.ur: Output wiring par short ya insulation fault.

solutions.en: Switch off heavy loads such as motors and pumps, restart the unit and see if it runs normally on a light load.
solutions.ur: Motor aur pump jaisi bhari load band kar dein, unit restart karein aur dekhein ke halke load par theek chal raha hai.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output and battery wiring for short circuits, loose terminals or burnt cables.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke output aur battery wiring check karein ke short circuit, dheele terminals ya jali hui cables to nahin.

solutions.en: If the error returns even on a light load, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Agar halke load par bhi error wapas aa jaye, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: Internal DC bus under-voltage trip.
meaning.ur: Andaruni DC bus under-voltage trip.

causes.en: Bus voltage is too low.
causes.ur: Bus voltage bohat kam.

causes.en: Weak or discharged battery feeding the DC bus.
causes.ur: Battery kamzor ya discharge hai jo DC bus ko feed kar rahi hai.

causes.en: Loose DC input connection or blown main fuse.
causes.ur: DC input ka connection dheela hai ya main fuse uda hua hai.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage under load with a multimeter; a weak battery is the usual reason the bus cannot hold voltage.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery ka voltage load par naapein; kamzor battery hi aam wajah hai ke bus voltage hold nahin kar pata.

solutions.en: Isolate supply and check the DC input cables, fuse and connections for looseness, corrosion or a blown fuse.
solutions.ur: Supply alag kar ke DC input cables, fuse aur connections check karein ke dheela, zang ya uda hua fuse to nahin.

solutions.en: Charge or replace the battery, restart once, and if the trip repeats send the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Battery charge ya replace kar ke ek baar restart karein, aur agar trip dobara aaye to unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; buzzer beeps continuously.

meaning.en: Inverter bridge failed to soft-start.
meaning.ur: Inverter bridge soft start nahi ho saka.

causes.en: Internal components failed.
causes.ur: Andaruni components kharab

causes.en: DC bus did not reach the level needed for bridge soft-start.
causes.ur: DC bus bridge soft-start ke liye zaroori level tak nahin pahuncha.

causes.en: Gate drive or IGBT stage fault in the inverter bridge.
causes.ur: Inverter bridge ka gate drive ya IGBT stage kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC input and PV and wait 5 minutes before opening the unit for a visual check.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute intezar karein, phir cover khol kar nazar se check karein.

solutions.en: Restart once after cooling; if the same code appears again the bridge or soft-start stage has failed.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad ek baar restart karein; agar phir se wohi code aaye to bridge ya soft-start stage kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Do not keep cycling power — return the unit to the repair centre for board repair.
solutions.ur: Bar bar power on-off na karein — unit ko board repair ke liye repair centre le jayein.

title.en: Over DC voltage in AC output
title.ur: AC output main DC voltage zyada

meaning.en: DC offset / unbalanced condition in AC output (troubleshooting phrasing: output voltage is unbalanced).
meaning.ur: AC output mein DC offset / unbalanced haalat hoti hai (troubleshooting mein: output voltage unbalanced hai).

causes.en: Output voltage is unbalanced / over DC voltage in AC output.
causes.ur: Output voltage unbalanced hai ya AC output mein DC voltage zyada hai.

causes.en: One output leg or relay contact has high resistance.
causes.ur: Kisi ek output leg ya relay contact par zyada resistance aa rahi hai.

causes.en: Output filter capacitor degraded.
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor kamzor ho gaya.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load, restart the unit and measure the AC output with a multimeter to confirm the unbalance.
solutions.ur: Munsalik load kam karein, unit restart karein aur multimeter se AC output naapein ke unbalance kitna hai.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output wiring and relay contacts for looseness or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Supply alag kar ke output wiring aur relay contacts check karein ke dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin.

solutions.en: If the output stays unbalanced even at no load, the output stage is faulty — return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Agar bina load ke bhi output unbalanced rahe, to output stage kharab hai — unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

meaning.en: Internal current sensor failure.
meaning.ur: Andaruni current sensor nakaam

causes.en: Internal components failed.
causes.ur: Andaruni components kharab

causes.en: Current sensor (CT/shunt) disconnected or damaged.
causes.ur: Current sensor (CT/shunt) disconnect ho gaya ya kharab hai.

causes.en: Main board sensing circuit fault.
causes.ur: Main board ki sensing circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, wait 5 minutes, then restart once to see whether the code clears.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute ruk kar ek baar restart karein aur dekhein ke code hat jata hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: Open the unit with power isolated and check that the current sensor (CT/shunt) connector is seated and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Power band kar ke unit kholein aur check karein ke current sensor (CT/shunt) ka connector theek laga hai ya kharab to nahin.

solutions.en: The sensor or its board circuit has failed — send the unit to the repair centre for replacement.
solutions.ur: Sensor ya us ka board circuit kharab ho gaya hai — unit ko replacement ke liye repair centre bhej dein.

meaning.en: Inverter output voltage low/abnormal (troubleshooting band: below ~190Vac).
meaning.ur: Inverter output voltage kam ya abnormal hai (troubleshooting had: 190Vac se neeche).

causes.en: Output abnormal (inverter voltage below 190Vac or higher than 260Vac).
causes.ur: output ghair mamooli (190Vac se kam ya 260Vac se zyada)

causes.en: Heavy load or long output cable causing voltage drop.
causes.ur: Bhari load ya lambi output cable ki wajah se voltage drop ho raha hai.

causes.en: Weak battery or failing output stage.
causes.ur: Battery kamzor hai ya output stage kharab ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load and restart; measure the AC output with a multimeter to see whether it stays below the limit.

solutions.en: Check the battery voltage under load and the output wiring for loose joints — both drag the output down.
solutions.ur: Load par battery voltage aur output wiring ke dheele joints check karein — dono output ko neeche kheenchte hain.

solutions.en: If the voltage is still low after these steps, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: In steps ke baad bhi voltage kam rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

meaning.en: PV input voltage exceeds the unit's PV limit.
meaning.ur: PV input voltage unit ki had se zyada

causes.en: PV input voltage is beyond the specification.
causes.ur: PV input voltage specification se bahar hai.

causes.en: Too many PV modules connected in series for this model.
causes.ur: Is model ke liye series mein PV modules zyada lage hue hain.

causes.en: Cold weather raised the array open-circuit voltage (Voc).
causes.ur: Sardi mein array ka open-circuit voltage (Voc) barh jata hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the PV DC isolator first, then measure the array open-circuit voltage (Voc) with a meter and compare it with the unit rating.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV DC isolator band karein, phir meter se array ka open-circuit voltage (Voc) naapein aur unit ki rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the string voltage is above the limit, reduce the number of PV modules in series and reconnect.
solutions.ur: Agar string ka voltage limit se upar ho, to series mein PV modules ki tadad kam kar ke dobara connect karein.

solutions.en: Check for damaged panels or water in the DC connectors; replace the faulty panel or connector and retest.
solutions.ur: Kharab panels ya DC connectors mein paani check karein; kharab panel ya connector badal kar dobara test karein.
